science.title: Canadian Fossil Discovery Centre unveils new Styxosaurus exhibit
science.description: Visitors to the Canadian Fossil Discovery Centre can now come face-to-face with one of Manitoba's ancient marine reptiles thanks to months of digital reconstruction and 3D printing. The museum recently unveiled a new Styxosaurus exhibit, featuring both a reconstructed skeleton and a life-sized model of the long-necked marine reptile based on a fossil discovered near Miami, Manitoba, in 1983. Eight months of reconstruction Executive Director Adolfo Cuetara said the project took roughly eight months to complete, beginning with the painstaking process of digitally scanning every original fossilized bone. ai.title: New York to impose the country's first statewide moratorium on data centers
ai.description: New York will block new large data centers that fuel artificial intelligence for up to a year to protect the environment and energy grid. Gov. Kathy Hochul is set to announce the move Tuesday, marking the country's first statewide moratorium on hyperscale data centers. These facilities require massive energy and water to cool thousands of servers. The order will pause state permitting and direct regulators to create standards addressing environmental impacts and energy demand. Tech companies argue this could hurt job growth and cede ground to China in AI development. The decision also carries political significance for Hochul's reelection campaign and the state's congressional races.
